title: NEXP lies in exponential nondeterministic time
statement: Every language in the certificate-defined class $\mathrm{NEXP}$ belongs to $\bigcup_{c\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{NTIME}(n\mapsto 2^{n^c})$.
replaced: Every language in the certificate-form class $\mathrm{NEXP}$ (given by a polynomial-time verifier with certificates of exact exponential length) belongs to $\bigcup_c \mathrm{NTIME}(2^{n^c})$.
